enemy-043-weyland-yutani-commando.designLock: Weyland-Yutani Commando directly targets the helmeted Alien 3 corporate commando in a sealed white APEsuit. Preserve a bulky but recognizably human silhouette: layered off-white pressure garment, tan reinforced padding, compact life-support backpack, gray metal/fiberglass helmet dome, asymmetric aluminum lower face cage and plate, hinged green-tinted welding goggles lowered over the eyes, black chin strap, covered face and heavy boots/gloves. This assault profile carries exactly one dark charcoal/black M41A Pulse Rifle in both hands, selected from the documented black-or-white film/licensed variants for maximum silhouette readability; it is not an NSG23, smartgun, energy rifle or generic assault rifle. The catch pole and knife are documented equipment but are not carried in this firearm/reload profile. Keep the rifle stock, upper shroud, barrel, foregrip and underslung launcher mass readable as one continuous weapon; never invent optics, suppressor, energy cells or floating attachments. Palette stays dirty off-white/cream, restrained tan padding, gray-silver hardware, dark joints and weapon, small desaturated green lenses; no olive Colonial Marine armor and no modern black tactical/ODST redesign. Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay profile, face hidden, backpack and rifle separated from the torso silhouette. Future pixels must be an original fan-made interpretation based on studied shape language, never a trace or copy of a film still, licensed miniature, product photo or official sprite.

topology.rule: Both hands remain anatomically connected and operate the same single M41A. Helmet, goggles, face cage, backpack and all limbs remain attached through every pose.

referenceLock.silhouette: Bulky sealed human pressure-suit silhouette with a distinctive oversized enclosed helmet, layered padded limbs, compact backpack and compact long gun held clear of the chest.
referenceLock.armorAndPalette: Dirty matte off-white/cream APEsuit, restrained tan reinforced panels, gray-silver helmet and fittings, dark joints/boots/gloves and dark charcoal M41A; small desaturated green welding lenses are the only saturated accent.
referenceLock.helmetAndVisor: Gray domed helmet; asymmetric aluminum plate-and-cage lower face protection; paired hinged green-tinted welding goggles locked down for combat; black chin retention. Face and hair are not visible.

weapon.finish: dark charcoal/black project choice from documented black-or-white variants
weapon.requiredRead: Recognizable compact M41A silhouette with stock/rear body, rectangular upper shroud, short barrel/foregrip and coherent underslung launcher mass.
weapon.reloadLogic: Magazine handling must follow one stable rifle construction; remove one magazine, insert one replacement, operate the action, return to ready.

referenceLock.facing: Strict right-facing orthographic gameplay side view in all 40 future poses; muzzle points right and never toward camera.

scale.gameplayRole: Human assault unit, bulkier than an unarmored human but within npc-standing gameplay class.
scale.rigidLandmark: Measure helmet dome height and the fixed butt-to-muzzle rifle length in comparable ready poses; cross-check shoulder-to-boot standing height.
scale.forbiddenMetric: Do not scale from muzzle flash, recoil reach, loose straps, backpack rods, corpse width or total pose bounding box.

rootAndGround.pivotStatus: queue precedent only; requires pose-by-pose physical-foot review after generation
rootAndGround.bodyRoot: Project pelvis mass to the support plane; the rifle and backpack never define the anchor.
rootAndGround.livePoses: At least one boot carries credible load; no skating, tiptoe hover or stance widening caused by per-frame rescale.
rootAndGround.death: Terminal root lies below the collapsed pelvis/torso, not below the rifle muzzle or backpack.

sourceContract.background: true transparent RGBA or perfectly uniform opaque #FF00FF
sourceContract.cellIsolation: Exactly one complete commando and the complete single rifle per cell; no limb, muzzle, backpack part, dropped magazine or debris crosses a cell boundary.
sourceContract.identityScale: One armor build, helmet, backpack, rifle and scale across idle, move, attack, death and reload.

move.rule: Disciplined heavy-suit patrol gait with rifle controlled in both hands; no sprint, hip-fire bob or cell translation.

attack.rule: One controlled M41A firing cycle. A tiny attached muzzle flash may be omitted; if used later it must remain subordinate, never alter anatomy/scale or cross a cell boundary.

death.rule: Irreversible human collapse. Rifle may settle beside the body but may not vanish, multiply, float or become the body anchor.

reload.rule: One readable weapon-specific reload with only one loose magazine visible at a time; no rifle redesign between frames.

prohibitions: No olive Colonial Marine M3 armor, exposed face, baseball helmet, gas mask or generic black tactical soldier.
No Fireteam-style modern SpecOps armor, ODST silhouette, power armor, exoskeleton or oversized sci-fi shoulder plates.
No white generic astronaut bubble helmet; retain the gray dome, face cage/plate and green welding goggles.
No invented optic, laser, suppressor, energy cell, bayonet, smartgun harness or alternate rifle.
No catch pole or knife in these armed/reload boards, no second weapon and no floating magazine outside reload.
No giant readable logo, invented unit number, text, scenery, floor, cast shadow, UI or watermark.
No left-facing, frontal or three-quarter pose, muzzle toward camera, crop, cell contact or copied official/licensed bitmap.
